tools.name: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-lint
tools.description: Find malformed JSON Schema and OpenAPI tool definitions in caller-supplied tools: bad types, required names that are not properties, empty enums, and duplicate tool names. Nothing is fetched. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/agent-tool-schema/tool-schema-lint. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment t

tools.name: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-ambiguity-detect
tools.description: Flag generic tool names, generic parameter names, and descriptions that repeat the name or are missing. Matching is against a fixed word list, not a language model. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/agent-tool-schema/tool-schema-ambiguity-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does n

tools.name: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-overlap-detect
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied tools for the same name, the same description text, or a very high overlap of longer words. Sharing a few keywords is not treated as a duplicate. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/agent-tool-schema/tool-schema-overlap-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and doe

tools.name: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-example-validate
tools.description: Check caller-supplied request examples against their JSON Schema types, required fields, enums, and bounds. External schema URLs are not fetched. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/agent-tool-schema/tool-schema-example-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-required-field-audit
tools.description: Find required names that are not properties, repeated required names, and required fields that also declare a default. The audit uses only the supplied schema. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/agent-tool-schema/tool-schema-required-field-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does no

tools.name: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-compatibility-check
tools.description: Report JSON Schema keywords that the caller-selected dialect does not allow. Targets are draft-07, 2020-12, OpenAPI 3.0, and OpenAPI 3.1. The schema is not sent to a validator service. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/agent-tool-schema/tool-schema-compatibility-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 p

tools.name: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-token-cost
tools.description: Estimate tokens for caller-supplied tool names, descriptions, and schemas at four characters per token. The figure is an estimate, not a provider tokenizer count. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/agent-tool-schema/tool-schema-token-cost. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-description-score
tools.description: Score whether a tool description states a purpose, inputs, outputs, and when to use it. The checks are phrase and length rules, not a language-model reading. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/agent-tool-schema/tool-schema-description-score. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent-tool-schema" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-ambiguity-detect, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-example-validate, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-compatibility-check · Private data: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-token-cost · Public sink: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-lint, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-ambiguity-detect, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-overlap-detect, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-example-validate, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-required-field-audit, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-compatibility-check, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-token-cost, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-description-score · Destructive: agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-lint, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-ambiguity-detect, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-overlap-detect, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-example-validate, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-required-field-audit, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-compatibility-check, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-token-cost, agent-tool-schema_tool-schema-description-score.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
